tools.name: create_company
tools.description: MUTATES Accelo data: creates a new company (client organization). Accelo API: POST /api/v0/companies (form-encoded). Returns { meta, response } with the created company. (Accelo has no separate delete tool here; to UPDATE, POST to /api/v0/companies/{id}.)

tools.name: create_contact
tools.description: MUTATES Accelo data: creates a new contact (a person). Accelo API: POST /api/v0/contacts (form-encoded). NOTE: a contact's company affiliation is set separately via an affiliation (POST /api/v0/contacts/{id}/affiliations), not on creation. Returns { meta, response } with the created contact.

tools.name: create_task
tools.description: MUTATES Accelo data: creates a new task. Accelo tasks are always logged AGAINST an object (a job, company, issue, etc.), so against_type + against_id are required. Accelo API: POST /api/v0/tasks (form-encoded). Returns { meta, response }.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_activities, get_activity, list_issues, get_issue · Private data: list_contacts, get_contact, create_contact · Public sink: get_activity, create_company, create_contact, create_task, create_activity · Destructive: create_company.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_activities, get_activity, list_issues, get_issue · Private data: list_contacts, get_contact, create_contact · Public sink: get_activity, create_company, create_contact, create_task, create_activity · Destructive: create_company

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
